newsitem.title: UK: Russia's SUN Brewing to make acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Russia's SUN Brewing to make acquisitions.

text.p: Russia's SUN Brewing plans to buy a 75.3 percent stake in the AO Povolzhe brewery in Volgograd and buy out a 25 percent minority stake in its existing brewery at Ivanovo.

"The acquisitions will be paid for by the issue of new securities to the vendors. SUN Brewing will also take the opportunity to raise cash for investment in plant and working capital," SUN said in a statement.
SUN, whose global depositary receipts (GDRs) are listed in Luxembourg will make a further announcement on its proposed share issue in November.
AO Povolzhe should add an annual 800,000 hectolitres of capacity to SUN's existing 3.3 million hectolitres of brewing capacity. It will also bring a malting plant with 20,000 tonnes of capacity.
SUN's net income was $1.38 million in the the second quarter of 1996 ended June 30, on sales of $58.8 million.
